provenance: wb-nqbd guard roster (the R694 follow-up of wb-maza landing 395, gate cmd_d35d53e6a40a: F1 leads, F2-F5 ride), cut by ws-03 (run g10-work-s96) on trunk 467b14b4bf0106677ab65fd79efb4c8a8c6990e9. The rules of every control were authored from the bead's findings before the widened reading existed (RED-1 of record: 28 of 28 kill controls read nothing on the landed reader); each finding's text was then measured by test/workbench-detached-timing-guard.test.ts on 467b14b plus the cut and reviewed against the finding it pins, so a control swapped to another case of the same rule reds. controls holds what each planted site of the guard yields, as '<rule> <text>' (F1, F2 and F3 kill controls; N negative controls, which yield nothing), residuals the quiet rows of each named residual (F5), raiseRows the family's raiseTransportLapse call rows (F5, R-RAISE-SITE), and tests the guard's collected test titles in order, '%s: ' opening a per-member rule row (F4, the frozen shape).
tests: judges every default-gate member of the family, read from the test directory and vitest.config.ts
pins the members that import the marked twins: the three suites that drive real hosts, and the helper's own unit rows
%s: G1 drives hosts only through the marked twins, never a raw launch or connect value import
%s: G2 holds no raw timer - a timed wait is pollFor and a held window is holdOpen
%s: G3 holds no fixed-count or clock-deadline poll loop (the pre-cure shape)
%s: G4 a hook that stops hosts reports a lapse only after its cleanup, under HOST_HOOK_TIMEOUT_MS
reads each rule's own shape: a planted member with one site per rule yields exactly its G1-G4 findings (instrument check)
wb-nqbd F4 frozen shape, as collected: this file's tests equal the roster's, expanded over the judged set, in order and in run mode, and the roster's shape equals the frozen-shape literal
wb-nqbd F1 kill controls: vitest's wait helpers and AbortSignal.timeout read as G2 - by name on any receiver, by a string key or through a destructured binding
wb-nqbd F2 kill controls: a for, while or do loop whose condition joins any relational bound with && reads as G3 - a countdown, a reversed or named bound, a while or do counter
wb-nqbd F3 kill controls: a timer global by a string key and Atomics.wait read as G2, and every vitest hook that stops hosts - itself or through module-local functions - reads as G4

wb-nqbd negative controls: a settled hook, a hook that stops nothing, a loop without && or without a relational bound, text alone and another object's members yield no finding; the controls are the roster's, in order
wb-nqbd F5 named residuals: every residual the header names has quiet rows in the roster, and each quiet row's planted member yields no finding
wb-nqbd F5 R-RAISE-SITE: the family's raiseTransportLapse call rows equal the roster's - socket-base's 60-byte TMPDIR row and the helper's own unit row
wb-nqbd F4 frozen shape, as run: this file's tests equal the roster's, expanded over the judged set, and every other test ran before this last case
